action.objective: Capture the f1 rook with the king, eliminating Black's second rook and keeping the extra exchange.
action.rationale: Only legal move is Kxf1, which captures Black's rook on f1 and removes the immediate check. Broad depth-4 search gives exact +735, safety probe complete with no mating reply, tactical_refutation not_found. After Kxf1 Black's remaining rook on c2 can take g2, but White stays up material with passed d/e pawns and the bishop on a5 pressing. No refutation found; commit.
